## 💡 Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## 🎯 Problem It Solves
What problem does this feature solve? What need does it address?

## 🛠️ Proposed Solution
How do you envision this feature working?

## 🔄 Alternatives Considered
What alternative solutions or features have you considered?

## 🌟 Benefits
How will this feature improve nixforhumanity.org or the Luminous Nix project?

## ♿ Accessibility Considerations
How will this feature affect accessibility? Any specific considerations?

## 📱 Mobile Considerations
How should this feature work on mobile devices?

## 🔗 Related Issues/PRs
Link any related issues or pull requests here.

## 📝 Additional Context
Add any other context, mockups, or examples about the feature request here.
